newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria president names interim finance minister.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria president names interim finance minister.

text.p: Bulgarian President Petar Stoyanov named on Wednesday current deputy finance minister Svetoslav Gavriiski as interim finance minister, president's spokeswoman said.
Gavriiski has been responsible for foreign debt payment coordination since 1990 and took part in the foreign debt negotiation team with official and commercial creditors in course of six governments.
Gavriiski will replace outgoing technocrat Dimitar Kostov.

Gavriiski will be expected to participate in talks with the International Monetary Fund preparing the implementation of a fixed exchange rate regime, the currency board. -- Elisaveta Konstantinova, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
